{"pos":["Unusual taste, odor, discoloration, cloudiness, or sediment reported at a single customer tap or premises","Low or no water pressure at one premises, or a request to test/verify pressure at the meter","Pipe banging/hammering, air in lines, or sputtering at a single premises; customer requests inspection or purge","Suspected leak at/near a premises or meter with no visible water, damage, or confirmed asset failure; inspection requested","Explicit start/stop service for a specific customer account or premises (activation/deactivation), including after-hours appointments"],"remap":["if visible standing water, water bubbling/gushing, sinkhole, or a confirmed break/leak in street/right-of-way, classify as Water Utility Problems instead","if city-owned hardware (meter box/lid, curb stop, valve, hydrant) is broken, missing, stuck, needs repair, or damaged by contractor/vehicle, classify as Water Utility Problems instead","if water discoloration/cloudiness persists multiple days or affects multiple addresses/area beyond one premises, classify as Water Utility Problems instead","if turn-on/turn-off requested without explicit account activation/deactivation language, or tied to repairs/curb-stop/valve operation, classify as Water Utility Problems instead"]}

{"pos":["Wastewater/sewer backup, overflow, clog, or slow drains implicating sanitary sewers, service laterals, mains, or manholes (indoors or discharging to street).","Sewer or rotten-egg/H2S odors, or symptoms attributed to sewer gas, indoors or outdoors.","Requests targeting sanitary-sewer assets: inspect/flush/jet/CCTV lines or manholes, or site restoration/yard repair explicitly tied to sewer main/lateral work.","Dye/smoke testing to verify sanitary-sewer connections, cross-connections, illicit connections, or service availability/status.","Failures, alarms, leaks, or overflows from lift/grinder stations, force mains, or private sewer ejector pumps, especially discharging wastewater to ground or street."],"remap":["if explicit potable-water asset (main/service line/meter/hydrant/valve) or drinking-water pressure/quality issue and no sewer-specific term/effect, classify as Water Utility Problems instead","if issue concerns storm drain, catch basin, storm sewer, culvert, or rain-driven street flooding, classify as Storm Drain Issues instead","if odor described as natural gas, propane, fuel, chemical, or carbon monoxide alarm, classify as Gas Utility Problems instead","if problem explicitly with private septic tank, leach field, or cesspool (onsite, not municipal), classify as Septic System Issues instead"]}

{"dimension":"Collection stream/program: which waste stream the issue belongs to (yard‑waste program vs general refuse), not the shared compliance cue (sticker/35‑gal/40‑lb) or event type (missed pickup).","gt_signal":"Explicit yard‑waste context—words like yard waste/brush/leaves/branches, program/seasonal cues, or a service event explicitly labeled as yard waste (e.g., “Missed pick‑up/yard waste”, yard‑waste courtesy pickup).","pr_signal":"No yard‑waste stream cues plus generic compliance/service language (sticker required, >35‑gal can, >40‑lb, missed pickup), which the system defaults to the refuse stream.","culprit":"Yard‑Waste NEG rules that (1) route any missed pickup to Trash even when “yard waste” is stated and (2) send sticker/35‑gal/weight violations without explicit yard‑waste terms to Trash.","fix":"Choose by stream first: keep anything explicitly tied to the yard‑waste program (including missed pickups/courtesy pickups) in Yard Waste, and use sticker/35‑gal/40‑lb only as secondary cues when no yard‑waste cue appears."}

{"dimension":"Responsibility/context: private‑property condition vs municipal trash collection/compliance","gt_signal":"Accumulation or overgrowth on private grounds (yard, back/side of house, porch, between houses, rear of property) with no curb/hauler/pickup/compliance context, even if described as 'trash', 'bags', or noting rodents","pr_signal":"Issues tied to the collection program or service points (stickers, can size, curb setout, missed/return pickup, crew handling, or overflowing carts/dumpsters placed for service)","culprit":"Excessive Growth neg rule that auto-routes any mention of household garbage/odor/rodents/dumpster to Trash, overriding private‑property context","fix":"Prefer private‑property context over waste keywords: classify as Excessive Growth whenever the mess is on a yard/porch/behind/side of a house without pickup/compliance/overflow cues, and reserve Trash for curbside/hauler or overflowing service-container issues."}

{"dimension":"Collection stream/program context (which service the issue belongs to: recycling vs trash), not the type of problem (missed pickup, weight, size, courtesy return).","gt_signal":"Any cue that the stream is recycling (recycling/recycle/blue cart/bin/recycle toters, or codes/context pointing to recycling); even if the issue is a miss, overweight, or can-too-big, it stays Recycling when the recycling stream is named or implied.","pr_signal":"Generic operational/compliance language without a recycling stream cue (missed pick‑up, courtesy pick up, crew going back, overweight, can too big, sticker codes) which the classifier maps by default to Trash.","culprit":"Recycling.neg rule that forces any collection failure to Trash, which overrode explicit recycling cues (and let generic weight/size violations default to Trash even when about recycling).","fix":"Prioritize stream identification before problem type: if the text indicates the recycling stream, classify as Recycling even for missed pickups or set‑out violations; reserve Trash for trash‑stream issues or when the stream is not specified."}

{"dimension":"request intent: operational collection/compliance issue vs yard‑waste program–specific requirement","gt_signal":"missed pickup/return-to-collect, or stream‑neutral compliance notes (40‑lb limit, 35‑gal can, missing sticker) stated without a clear yard‑waste program anchor","pr_signal":"explicit yard‑waste stream plus program‑specific prep/timing/fee/season cues (plastic bags, bundling sticks/branches, $1 sticker, winter suspension, courtesy pickup, christmas tree)","culprit":"the Yard Waste positive rule that treats 40‑lb/35‑gal/sticker (or mere 'yardwaste/leaves' mention) as sufficient without requiring a yard‑waste program anchor","fix":"Require an explicit yard‑waste stream anchor tied to a program prep/timing/fee cue for Yard Waste, and prioritize any missed-collection or stream‑neutral 40‑lb/35‑gal/sticker violations to Trash even if leaves/yardwaste are mentioned."}

{"dimension":"Type of abatement needed: discrete waste cleanup/removal vs ongoing vegetation/property maintenance","gt_signal":"It asks for removal of discarded material (trash/litter/junk/bulky items or piles like boards/stone/brush) left lying about—even on private yards or in alleys/streets—with no mowing/trimming context; a cleanup task rather than property upkeep.","pr_signal":"It describes living vegetation height/encroachment or general property overgrowth that requires maintenance (mowing, trimming, cutting), not the pickup of refuse.","culprit":"Trash.neg: \"if accumulation on private grounds (yard/behind/beside/lot) with no curbside/hauler/dumpster/cart context, classify as Excessive Growth instead\" (overrides household-garbage/litter cleanup on private property).","fix":"Treat any request to remove discarded waste/litter/junk (including piles in yards/alleys/streets, even when source is unknown) as Trash, and reserve Excessive Growth for living vegetation overgrowth/encroachment that needs mowing/trimming rather than refuse cleanup."}

{"dimension":"Source/system of the water: stormwater drainage/runoff vs potable-water distribution infrastructure","gt_signal":"Runoff/drainage context: street ponding/flooding, ditches/culverts/inlets/standpipes, “storm”/poor drainage terms, or erosion/flooding tied to grading/development, including requests to install/maintain drainage components (even if on private property)","pr_signal":"Explicit potable-water assets (main/service/hydrant/curb stop/valve/meter/pit/lid), area-wide discoloration/grit, restoration after water-utility work, or unexplained persistent yard saturation with no stormwater terms","culprit":"Over-broad Water Utility POS rule for “persistent standing water on private property with no rain/storm terms,” which, along with generic “pipe,” overrides clear stormwater/street/drainage cues","fix":"Base classification on the water’s origin: treat street ponding, storm/ditch/culvert/inlet/standpipe mentions, and development/grading-driven drainage or erosion as stormwater even on private property or without the word ‘rain,’ and reserve Water Utility for explicit potable-water assets or truly unexplained yard saturation."}

{"dimension":"Public-roadway driver sightline hazard vs private-property overgrowth or ambiguous visibility","gt_signal":"Mentions a specific yard/hedge/house/driveway or neighbor’s lot; lacks a clear driver-on-public-street action or omits the named street being entered; generic “can’t see” or pedestrian/cul‑de‑sac visibility; address-based private context","pr_signal":"Explicit roadway safety context: drivers’ ability to see traffic or control devices on a named public street/intersection, vegetation in/onto the road or ROW, or clear pull‑out/exit phrasing tied to a public street","culprit":"Over-weighting of “intersection”/“pull out” as Line of Sight triggers without requiring a named public street or excluding private‑yard/hedge origins","fix":"Only label Line of Sight when the complaint clearly anchors the visibility hazard to drivers on a named public street/intersection or traffic device in the right‑of‑way; otherwise—especially when tied to a specific yard/hedge/driveway or missing the entered street—treat as Excessive Growth."}

{"dimension":"Request intent: operational collection/return-to-collect vs recycling compliance/education","gt_signal":"Mentions of a service failure or return request (missed/not picked up/please pick up/crew went out) or generic unacceptable container/set‑out without explicit recycling‑program context","pr_signal":"Only sorting/contamination/preparation or recycling‑container logistics are discussed, with no pickup failure or collection request","culprit":"The Recycling positive rule that fires on “explicit recycling cue + not sorted/contamination” is outranking/ignoring the negation for collection failures (e.g., “Recycle was not picked up … not sorted”), overgeneralizing on words like “recycle” and “not sorted.”","fix":"Make collection/return-to-collect cues (missed/not picked up/return requested) override any recycling sorting or contamination language, and keep an item in Recycling only when it is purely a preparation/compliance or recycling-container issue without a pickup failure."}

{"dimension":"Which utility system and medium the report targets: wastewater collection (sewer assets/events) vs potable-water distribution (drinking-water assets/events).","gt_signal":"Sewer-specific assets or effects are named: manhole/manhole cover, sewer main/lateral, lift/grinder/ejector (sewer) pump; or sewer symptoms like clogs/backups/slow drains/sewer odors; or restoration explicitly tied to sewer work—even if the liquid is called “water” or is running in the street.","pr_signal":"Potable-water system cues: water mains/services/meters/hydrants/valves, meter-pit lids, suspected main breaks, standing water with no sewer/storm context, whole-house discoloration/quality issues, or excavation restoration not tied to sewer.","culprit":"Over-broad Water Utility positives fired on surface cues—“leaking water running down street,” generic “yard repair,” and “cover/lid off”—without requiring potable-water assets, overriding sewer cues like “sewer pump,” “sewer main,” “manhole,” and “clog/plumber ran lines.”","fix":"Require explicit potable-water assets to trigger Water Utility, and when sewer assets or sewer symptoms (manhole, sewer pump, sewer main/lateral, clog/plumber ran lines) are present, prefer Sewer Problems even if words like water, cover/lid off, or yard repair appear."}

{"dimension":"Intent of dispatch: utility field operations on distribution assets vs single‑premise water condition/account service","gt_signal":"Request implies sending a crew to operate/repair utility hardware (curb stop/valve) or to check a potential leak—i.e., infrastructure control/repair—even if the leak is only suspected or the request is after‑hours; turn‑ons/offs not framed as account activation","pr_signal":"Single‑premise sensory/pressure/noise complaints at the tap, or an explicit start/stop tied to customer account activation/deactivation","culprit":"Over-broad Water Quality positive rules: 'Explicit start/stop service...' firing on any 'turn on/off' (and 'after hours') without the account-activation qualifier, and 'Suspected leak... no visible water' catching 'possible water leak' that should dispatch field ops","fix":"Key off intent to work on utility assets: treat non‑account turn‑ons/offs and any 'possible leak' as Water Utility Problems, reserving Water Quality for single‑premise taste/odor/pressure/noise issues and explicit account activation/deactivation."}

{"dimension":"confirmed utility-side asset failure vs single-premises symptom/inspection (including appliance issues)","gt_signal":"single-customer complaints or inspections with no field evidence: vague 'leak' without visible water/damage, mentions near the meter pit/curb or 'in front' with no flow, and appliance/water-heater troubles","pr_signal":"explicit signs of utility asset failure or field hazard: visible/standing water or flow, named broken utility hardware (main, valve, meter lid), area/persistent water quality disturbance, or repair/restoration needs","culprit":"overweighting the tokens 'leak' and 'meter pit/front' to match Water Utility Problems’ asset-failure rule without enforcing the 'visible/confirmed' requirement, and no pattern to route appliance-only complaints to Water Quality","fix":"Default single-premises, unverified symptoms (including appliance-only issues and vague ‘leak’ near meter pits/curb/front without visible water or damage) to Water Quality, reserving Water Utility Problems only for stated breaks, standing water/flow, damaged utility hardware, or named main/valve failures."}

{"dimension":"Type/source of the obstruction: vegetative/yard-waste from a property vs freestanding man‑made/staged objects in the right‑of‑way","gt_signal":"Mentions natural growth or debris (weeds, limbs, logs, fallen tree) originating from a property or yard waste, sometimes spilling into ROW, with no dumpsters/trailers/equipment involved","pr_signal":"Focus on the facility being blocked (alley/sidewalk, “in the middle,” “obstructed,” “hazard”) without regard to what the blocker is, plus ROW terms like alley/sidewalk","culprit":"Blocked Street positive rule \"Physical obstruction that blocks or significantly narrows a public travelway\" triggered by words like alley/sidewalk/obstructed, overriding the yard‑waste exception","fix":"When the blocking material is vegetative debris/yard waste (weeds, limbs, logs, fallen tree) from a property, classify as Excessive Growth even if it blocks an alley/sidewalk; reserve Blocked Street for placed objects or equipment/staging in the ROW."}

{"dimension":"Road-safety sightline for motorists on public streets vs private‑property vegetation maintenance/encroachment","gt_signal":"Driver‑centric visibility hazard: mentions of seeing oncoming traffic or traffic‑control, or needing to pull out/turn/merge onto a public street, intersection/corner/median/right‑of‑way context, or a Risk Management sight‑distance safety report","pr_signal":"Focus on overgrown grass/weeds/bushes tied to a specific private lot/yard or sidewalk/driveway encroachment, with no motorist sightline or driving maneuver on a public street","culprit":"Line of Sight neg rule: \"if vegetation originates from a specific private property’s yard, hedge, fence, or lot, classify as Excessive Growth instead\"","fix":"Treat any complaint describing a motorists’ sightline hazard affecting travel on a public street (including Risk Management safety flags) as Line of Sight even if the vegetation is on private property; reserve Excessive Growth for private‑lot maintenance or pedestrian encroachment without a driving‑sightline context."}

{"dimension":"Service stream/program context (yard‑waste program vs generic trash) rather than the generic violation/event type","gt_signal":"Any cue that the yard‑waste stream/rules are being enforced: explicit 'yard waste/brush/leaves/branches', the program’s numeric limits (40‑lb weight, 35‑gal container), yard‑waste stickers/fees or seasonal notes, or even a missed collection explicitly tied to yard waste","pr_signal":"No yard‑waste stream cues; the text only states a generic curbside trash event (missed pickup) or a generic set‑out violation (overweight, 35‑gal can, missing sticker) without tying it to yard waste","culprit":"Yard Waste neg rules that force (a) missed pickup—even when 'yard waste' is named—and (b) sticker/35‑gal notes without explicit yard‑waste terms into Trash; reinforced by Trash pos matching generic overweight/oversize/sticker language","fix":"Prioritize stream identification over violation type: when text signals the yard‑waste program (explicit 'yard waste' or its rule cues like 40‑lb/35‑gal limits or yard‑waste stickers/season), classify as Yard Waste even if the note is a missed pickup or a generic compliance warning."}

{"dimension":"Responsibility/context: private‑property condition vs municipal trash collection/compliance","gt_signal":"Accumulation or overgrowth on private grounds (yard, back/side of house, porch, between houses, rear of property) with no curb/hauler/pickup/compliance context, even if described as 'trash', 'bags', or noting rodents","pr_signal":"Issues tied to the collection program or service points (stickers, can size, curb setout, missed/return pickup, crew handling, or overflowing carts/dumpsters placed for service)","culprit":"Excessive Growth neg rule that auto-routes any mention of household garbage/odor/rodents/dumpster to Trash, overriding private‑property context","fix":"Prefer private‑property context over waste keywords: classify as Excessive Growth whenever the mess is on a yard/porch/behind/side of a house without pickup/compliance/overflow cues, and reserve Trash for curbside/hauler or overflowing service-container issues."}

{"dimension":"Program/stream context (which waste stream the ticket is about) vs. generic service outcome/compliance (missed pickup, size/weight, stickers)","gt_signal":"It’s explicitly in the recycling stream (mentions recycle/recycling/blue cart/bin/toter or a missed recycling pickup), i.e., the problem is about the recycling program even if the issue is a miss, can size, weight, or a courtesy return","pr_signal":"Issue-type cues without stream gating: missed/partial pickup, courtesy return, overweight, oversize can—treated as Trash regardless of whether the stream is recycling","culprit":"Trash.pos rules for missed collection and set‑out violations are applied stream‑agnostically, and Recycling.neg wrongly forces any collection failure (even for recycling) into Trash","fix":"Gate on stream first: if the text indicates the recycling program/cart, classify under Recycling even when the complaint is a missed pickup or set‑out/weight/size violation; reserve Trash for cases with no recycling stream indicated."}

{"dimension":"Material/waste stream and service intent: sanitation cleanup of household refuse vs property vegetation/junk maintenance","gt_signal":"Mentions of household garbage/litter/bagged trash or dumped bulky household items needing removal (putrescible waste likely to smell/attract animals), regardless of being in a yard, alley, or behind a house","pr_signal":"Focus on private‐property neglect or overgrowth (weeds/grass/brush) or stored non‑garbage materials (boards/junk) without a sanitation/cleanup cue, often framed as yard maintenance","culprit":"Trash NEG rule: \"if accumulation on private grounds (yard/behind/beside/lot) with no curbside/hauler/dumpster/cart context, classify as Excessive Growth instead\"","fix":"Decide by waste type, not location: treat any household trash/litter or bagged/dumped household waste as Trash even on private property, and reserve Excessive Growth for vegetation or non‑garbage junk/overgrowth."}

{"dimension":"Public-road driving maneuver context vs private-property overgrowth origin (driver action on a named roadway vs property maintenance/encroachment)","gt_signal":"Source is a specific yard/hedge/fence/house or \"yard overgrown,\" or the complaint lacks the name of the public street being entered; visibility is framed as property overgrowth or an ambiguous corner/intersection without clear driver action on a named street.","pr_signal":"Describes a driver maneuver (pull out/turn/see cross‑traffic) at a public roadway and names the street/intersection or locates the vegetation in the public right‑of‑way/median/shoulder or blocking a traffic control device.","culprit":"Line of Sight positives are over-weighted for words like \"intersection\" and \"pull out/can't see,\" ignoring negatives that require a named public street being entered and that exclude vegetation tied to a specific private property.","fix":"Treat reports as Line of Sight only when tied to a driving maneuver onto a named public street or vegetation clearly in the public right‑of‑way; otherwise, especially when tied to a specific private yard/hedge/fence or lacking the named street being entered, treat as Excessive Growth."}

{"dimension":"Origin/system of the water and asset domain: storm-runoff drainage work vs potable-water utility infrastructure failure/work","gt_signal":"Mentions of rain/storm/drainage context, street/right‑of‑way ponding, erosion/flooding tied to grading/development, or requests to install/adjust drainage assets (ditch/culvert/inlet/catch basin/standpipe/storm pipe, upstream/outfall)","pr_signal":"Presence of potable-water assets or actions (main/service, curb stop/valve, hydrant, meter/pit/lid, shutoff/turn-on), suspected main break/after‑hours dispatch, or unexplained continuous surfacing water/yard saturation without any storm/drainage context, or restoration explicitly from water-utility work","culprit":"Over-broad match to generic phrases like “standing water”/“water coming up” under Water Utility POS rule 2, while missing drainage-context cues (ditch/culvert/storm pipe, street ponding, development/erosion) and treating “yard”/“pipe” as potable by default","fix":"Prioritize storm/drainage context (rain, street ponding, ditch/culvert/inlet/standpipe, development/erosion) as a decisive signal for Sidewalk Snow Removal, and require explicit potable-water asset or leak/break cues before assigning Water Utility Problems."}

{"dimension":"Intent of the request: operational collection/hauler action vs. recycling-preparation education/compliance","gt_signal":"A service failure or hauler action is stated or requested (missed/not picked up, return/go back, crew went out/picked, deliver/replace container) — an operational correction even if recycling/contamination is mentioned.","pr_signal":"Only preparation/contamination guidance about the recycling stream (unsorted, trash mixed in, non‑recyclables, bottles/cans instructions) with no pickup failure or hauler action.","culprit":"Recycling positive rule “explicit recycling cue + unsorted/contamination/preparation” triggered on phrases like “recycles not sorted” and “trash mixed in,” overriding or missing collection‑failure/crew‑action cues (e.g., not picked, crew went out).","fix":"Prioritize collection/hauler‑action language (missed/not picked up/return/crew went out/deliver/replace) over recycling‑prep keywords so any operational return or container replacement is Trash even when recycling terms appear."}

{"dimension":"Which utility system is implicated by the problem: sanitary wastewater collection vs potable water distribution","gt_signal":"Wastewater intent/effects or assets: backups/clogs/slow drains/rotten-egg sewer odors; explicit sewer components (sewer main/lateral/manhole, lift/grinder/private ejector pump), requests to jet/CCTV/flush sewers, or restoration explicitly tied to sewer work","pr_signal":"Potable-water distribution assets/actions (water main/service/hydrant/valve/meter, shutoffs), suspected main breaks or unexplained surfacing/standing water with no sewer indicators, or restoration explicitly tied to water-utility work","culprit":"Over-broad Water Utility positives for surfacing/standing water and utility-restoration fired on generic 'leaking water/running down street' and 'yard repair' phrases, outscoring explicit sewer cues (sewer pump, clog, sewer main)","fix":"Prioritize sewer-specific symptoms and assets—including private ejector/lift pumps and restoration after sewer main/lateral work—over generic water/leak/surfacing language; use Water Utility only when a potable-water asset/problem is named or no sewer context is present."}

{"pos":["Vegetation in public right-of-way blocks a motorist’s view of traffic or traffic-control devices on a named public street","At a named intersection/corner of public streets, vegetation obstructs motorists’ sightlines to cross-traffic or approaching vehicles","Vegetation in a public roadway median, island, shoulder, or ditch creates a sight-distance hazard for drivers","Vegetation along a public road prevents drivers from seeing to enter, turn onto, or merge onto a named public street","A Risk Management or traffic-safety referral identifies a vegetation-caused sight-distance hazard on a public roadway"],"remap":["if vegetation is explicitly from a specific private property’s yard, hedge, fence, or lot (by address or owner), classify as Excessive Growth instead","if a driveway/alley/parking-lot visibility complaint omits the name of the public street being entered, classify as Excessive Growth instead","if the concern is sidewalk/path encroachment or pedestrian visibility rather than motorists’ sightlines, classify as Excessive Growth instead","if no named public street or intersection and vegetation is described only as overgrown/tall weeds/bushes, classify as Excessive Growth instead"]}

{"pos":["Reports of clogged or blocked storm drains, inlets, catch basins, driveway culverts, ditches, swales, or standpipes.","Storm sewer or stormwater pipe backing up, surcharging, overflowing, or not conveying runoff during or after rain.","Standing water on streets or public right-of-way without potable-water asset, leak, pressure, or break terms.","Requests to install, repair, adjust, or maintain stormwater assets: inlets, culverts, storm pipes, outfalls, standpipes, ditches, swales, or upstream risers.","Drainage or erosion complaints tied to grading, development, or parking-lot changes affecting storm runoff paths or outfalls."],"remap":["if mentions water mains/service lines, meters, valves, hydrants, shutoffs, pressure/supply, or water-quality, classify as Water Utility Problems instead.","if yard-only standing water lacks rain/storm/drain/ditch/inlet words and suggests a leak or break, classify as Water Utility Problems instead.","if mentions sanitary sewer backups, manholes overflowing, sewer laterals, or sewage odors, classify as Sewer Problems instead.","if complaint concerns snow or ice on sidewalks, plowing/salting, or failure to shovel sidewalks, classify as Street Snow Removal instead."]}

{"pos":["Confirmed or visible failure of potable-water assets—main/service/hydrant/valve/curb stop/meter/pit/lid—causing leakage/flow, damage, unsafe condition, or loss of control.","Water actively surfacing from ground (bubbling/flowing/hissing/icing) without storm-drain context, indicating a buried potable main/service leak on or near property.","Requests to operate/repair potable-water control points (curb stop/valve/hydrant) or perform non-account shutoff/turn-on for repairs, leak isolation, or contractor work.","Distribution-side investigation: suspected main/service break, after-hours/EM dispatch, or brown/discolored/gritty water lasting many hours or affecting multiple units/blocks.","Restoration explicitly tied to water-utility excavation or meter/main/service work: reseeding, backfill settlement, cleanup, driveway/sidewalk/yard repair, or inquiries about who will restore."],"remap":["if rain/storm context, street ponding, or stormwater assets (ditch/culvert/inlet/catch basin/standpipe/outfall) or erosion/grading/development are mentioned, classify as Sidewalk Snow Removal instead.","if sewer assets/symptoms occur—sewer main/lateral/manhole, lift/grinder/ejector pump, backups/clogs/slow drains/sewer odors—or restoration after sewer work, classify as Sewer Problems (Sanitary Sewers) instead.","if single-premises taste/odor/color/pressure/noise or terse 'leak at front/meter/curb' without visible flow/damage or hardware operation request, classify as Water Quality instead.","if water turn-on/off is explicitly for move-in/move-out or account activation/deactivation (start/stop service, billing), classify as Water Quality instead."]}

{"pos":["Wastewater backup/overflow/clog, slow drains, or gurgling across fixtures, or sewage on ground/street; mentions sewer, service lateral, main, or manhole.","Reports of sewer/rotten-egg/H2S odors, or sewer gas symptoms, indoors or outdoors, without natural-gas context.","Requests to jet/flush/CCTV/inspect sanitary sewers or manholes, or to verify connections via dye/smoke tests.","Failures, alarms, leaks, or overflows from lift/grinder stations, force mains, or private sewer ejector pumps; wastewater discharging to ground or street.","Restoration or yard repair explicitly tied to municipal sanitary-sewer main/lateral work or cleanouts."],"remap":["if explicit potable-water asset (main, service line, meter, hydrant, valve) or drinking-water pressure/quality with no sewer terms, classify as Water Utility Problems instead","if issue concerns storm drain, catch basin, storm sewer, culvert, or rain-only street flooding, classify as Storm Drain Issues instead","if odor is natural gas/propane, gas meter/appliance involved, or gas company notified, classify as Gas Utility Problems instead","if problem explicitly involves private septic tank, leach field, or cesspool (onsite wastewater systems), classify as Septic System Issues instead"]}

{"pos":["Single-premises tap complaint of unusual taste, odor, color, cloudiness, or sediment; customer seeks testing, flushing guidance, or investigation.","Single-premises hydraulic symptoms: low/no pressure, pressure surges, air/sputter, or pipe banging/rattling; request to check/measure at meter without repair.","Single-premises suspected leak with no visible flow, damage, or saturation; near meter pit/curb/front yard; inspection only, no hardware operation requested.","Interior plumbing or appliance issue affecting water quality, temperature, or pressure at one premises; seeking advice or tests, not utility repair.","Explicit account start/stop for a specific premises (activation/deactivation) tied to move-in/out or scheduled appointment, including after-hours."],"remap":["if visible running/standing water, bubbling, sinkhole, or a confirmed break/leak in street/right-of-way, or generic leak report without single-premises symptom/location, classify as Water Utility Problems instead","if asked to operate, repair, or replace city-owned hardware (meter, box/lid, curb stop, valve, hydrant), classify as Water Utility Problems instead","if turn-on/turn-off is requested without explicit account activation/deactivation or move-in/out, classify as Water Utility Problems instead","if brown/discolored water persists days/weeks or affects multiple premises/streets, or area-wide pressure loss, classify as Water Utility Problems instead"]}
